name: PT 5430
title: Functional-Biomechanical Relationships
description: Students will receive detailed descriptions and analyses of structures of the musculoskeletal system in general as well as within individual functional regions. Students will also examine how structure affects function within each region. Lastly, they will also examine the forces sustained by the various regions during function, in normal and pathological conditions thus preparing them to apply knowledge of normal anatomical structure and function to therapeutic intervention.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
